scope: Read-only wake definition audit plus plot-only dimension/status correction; no solver rerun or data changes.

native_field.case: IBM cylinder Re=30, D=1, center_x=0, final accepted t=60 s

reference.source: Constant et al., Implementation of a discrete Immersed Boundary Method in OpenFOAM, arXiv:1609.04364, Figure 10 and Table 2
reference.note: Figure 10 defines wake recirculation length; Table 2 reports 1.64-1.66 in present Re30 simulations and 1.55-1.70 across comparison literature.

conclusion: Existing function already subtracts the rear surface x=0.5D. Subtracting another 0.5D would be incorrect; genuine result remains outside the published reference band. No physical criteria or solver settings changed.
plot_changes: Wake endpoint marker now uses L/D when plotted on x/D axis, correct for D not equal to one.
Reference status now uses exact published range rather than silent 10% padding.
Recirculation helper accepts body center for translated-body unit tests; current case remains center zero.

verification.visual: Red marker at measured x/D=2.637; published band ends x/D=2.20, visibly outside.
